scope: Native PromQL compiler: defer dropMetricName only for a direct range function over a direct RangeSelector constrained to one nonempty exact __name__, immediately consumed by a one-argument series aggregation that discards __name__. Remove the redundant per-series anyForEach/countForEach duplicate-check GROUP BY and intermediate tag copies. Leave range rollup semantics, IDs, TAGS/TimeRanges/SAMPLES, R30/R31 JOINs, R34 map capacity and R33 fixtures unchanged. This is not the R20 SQL sum/count rewrite.
reason: On sets with a constant metric name, removing that name is injective. The per-series range aggregate already has unique full-tag groups. A safe immediate parent that discards __name__ can perform the only needed label projection. Mixed metrics, subqueries, offsets, explicit by(__name__), binary operators, and nonstandard parent aggregations retain the stock path.
